Core website features

Built to sell. Easy to run.

Excursion catalogueA page per tour with photos, duration, inclusions, pickup times and price per person.
Taxi & transfer bookingAirport, cruise port and hotel transfers with flight number, passengers, luggage and vehicle choice.
Booking engineDate and time picker, live availability, blackout dates, group size, add-ons and confirmation email.
Online paymentsCard payments for a deposit or the full amount, plus a pay-on-arrival option.
WhatsApp & contactClick-to-WhatsApp on every page, contact form and Google Maps location.
Reviews & galleryTestimonials, photo gallery and links to TripAdvisor and Google reviews.
Admin dashboardConfirm, reschedule and cancel bookings; update tours, fares and blackout dates. Private to the Xcape team.
Mobile-first designFast on phones, where most visitors browse and book.
SEO & analyticsSearch-optimised pages, Google Business Profile link-up and visitor analytics.
Cart, wishlist & trip boardSave tours, build several days in one cart and drag stops between days before checkout.

AI Companion running cost

Claude, priced by use.

The Companion runs on Claude, Anthropic's AI model. It is billed monthly by usage, so it sits outside the EC$5,000 build fee.

Itineraries planned per monthClaude Sonnet 5.5 (recommended)Claude Haiku 5.5 (budget)
250≈ US$16≈ US$1
500≈ US$31≈ US$2
1,000≈ US$62≈ US$3
2,000≈ US$124≈ US$6

Estimate per itinerary conversation: about 30,000 input tokens (two-thirds served from prompt cache) and 4,000 output tokens. Rates from Anthropic's published pricing as of October 2026: Sonnet 5.5 at US$2 input / US$10 output per million tokens; Haiku 5.5 at US$0.10 / US$0.50. Actual cost depends on conversation length.

Recommendation: start on Claude Sonnet 5.5 for the best itineraries and set a monthly spending cap of US$50 in the Anthropic account. Simple FAQ answers can go to Haiku 5.5 to keep costs down as traffic grows.

Terms & next steps

Ready when you are.

This proposal is valid for 30 days. Up to two rounds of design revisions are included; scope changes after design approval are quoted before work starts; the website and all content become Xcape's property on final payment.

  1. Review the proposal and the demos, and send any questions.
  2. Download the agreement, choose a care plan (optional) and sign.
